items.question: Trong câu "Which initiatives should the enterprise invest in, and why?", từ "invest in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which initiatives should the enterprise invest in, and why?", what does "invest in" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to put money or effort into
items.explanation: invest in /ɪnˈvest ɪn/ (cụm từ): đầu tư vào. "Invest in" = đầu tư (tiền, thời gian, công sức) vào; "invest time in training" = đầu tư thời gian cho đào tạo.
items.explanationEn: invest in /ɪnˈvest ɪn/ (phrase): to put money or effort into. "Invest in" works for money, time or effort, as in "invest time in training".

items.question: Trong câu "Which initiatives should the enterprise invest in, and why?", từ "enterprise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which initiatives should the enterprise invest in, and why?", what does "enterprise" (noun) mean?
options: tinh thần dám nghĩ dám làm
items.explanation: enterprise /ˈen.tər.praɪz/ (danh từ): doanh nghiệp, tổ chức. "Enterprise-wide" = trên toàn doanh nghiệp; nghĩa khác là tinh thần dám làm (show enterprise).
items.explanationEn: enterprise /ˈen.tər.praɪz/ (noun): a business or organisation. "Enterprise-wide" means across the whole company; enterprise can also mean boldness.

items.question: Trong câu "How should this initiative be shaped and sequenced to reach the outcome?", từ "shape" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How should this initiative be shaped and sequenced to reach the outcome?", what does "shape" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shape /ʃeɪp/ (động từ): định hình. "Shape a strategy / an initiative" = định hình chiến lược / sáng kiến.
items.explanationEn: shape /ʃeɪp/ (verb): to give form to. "Shape a strategy / an initiative" means give it form and direction.

items.question: Trong câu "How should this initiative be shaped and sequenced to reach the outcome?", từ "sequence" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How should this initiative be shaped and sequenced to reach the outcome?", what does "sequence" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (động từ): sắp theo trình tự. "Sequence the work" = sắp thứ tự công việc; trong sinh học sequence DNA = giải trình tự gen.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (verb): to arrange in order. "Sequence the work" means put it in order; in biology you sequence DNA.

items.question: Trong câu "The three are not sequential phases.", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three are not sequential phases.", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): nối tiếp nhau. "Sequential" = tuần tự; trái nghĩa với concurrent/parallel (song song).
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): following one after another. "Sequential" is the opposite of concurrent or parallel.

items.question: Trong câu "The three are not sequential phases.", từ "phase" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three are not sequential phases.", what does "phase" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: phase /feɪz/ (danh từ): giai đoạn. "Phase 1 / the next phase" = giai đoạn 1 / giai đoạn tiếp; "phase out" = loại bỏ dần.
items.explanationEn: phase /feɪz/ (noun): a stage in a process. "The next phase" is a stage; "phase out" means remove gradually.

items.question: Trong câu "They run concurrently: while the team is delivering this iteration, the initiative is still being resequenced and the portfolio is still being evaluated.", từ "concurrently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They run concurrently: while the team is delivering this iteration, the initiative is still being resequenced and the portfolio is still being evaluated.", what does "concurrently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: concurrently /kənˈkɜːr.ənt.li/ (trạng từ): đồng thời. "Run concurrently" = chạy song song; tính từ concurrent.
items.explanationEn: concurrently /kənˈkɜːr.ənt.li/ (adverb): at the same time. "Run concurrently" means in parallel; the adjective is concurrent.

items.question: Trong câu "They run concurrently: while the team is delivering this iteration, the initiative is still being resequenced and the portfolio is still being evaluated.", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They run concurrently: while the team is delivering this iteration, the initiative is still being resequenced and the portfolio is still being evaluated.", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): vòng lặp phát triển. "Iteration" = một vòng lặp (thường 1–4 tuần) trong agile; động từ iterate = lặp lại.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): one repeated cycle of work. "Iteration" is one short work cycle in agile; the verb is iterate.

items.question: Trong câu "They run concurrently: while the team is delivering this iteration, the initiative is still being resequenced and the portfolio is still being evaluated.", từ "evaluate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They run concurrently: while the team is delivering this iteration, the initiative is still being resequenced and the portfolio is still being evaluated.", what does "evaluate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evaluate /ɪˈvæl.ju.eɪt/ (động từ): đánh giá. "Evaluate options / performance" = đánh giá phương án / hiệu suất; danh từ evaluation.
items.explanationEn: evaluate /ɪˈvæl.ju.eɪt/ (verb): to assess. "Evaluate options / performance" are common; the noun is evaluation.

items.question: Trong câu "They run concurrently: while the team is delivering this iteration, the initiative is still being resequenced and the portfolio is still being evaluated.", từ "portfolio" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They run concurrently: while the team is delivering this iteration, the initiative is still being resequenced and the portfolio is still being evaluated.", what does "portfolio" (noun) mean?
options: hồ sơ tác phẩm cá nhân
optionsEn: a set of projects or investments
items.explanation: portfolio /pɔːrtˈfoʊ.li.oʊ/ (danh từ): danh mục (dự án, đầu tư). "Project portfolio" = danh mục dự án; nghĩa khác là hồ sơ tác phẩm (design portfolio).
items.explanationEn: portfolio /pɔːrtˈfoʊ.li.oʊ/ (noun): a set of projects or investments. "Project portfolio" is a set of projects; a design portfolio is a collection of your work.

items.question: Trong câu "The three timeframes are worth memorising outright", từ "timeframe" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three timeframes are worth memorising outright", what does "timeframe" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: timeframe /ˈtaɪm.freɪm/ (danh từ): khung thời gian. "Within a timeframe of" = trong khung thời gian; "tight timeframe" = thời gian gấp.
items.explanationEn: timeframe /ˈtaɪm.freɪm/ (noun): a period of time. "Within a timeframe of" and "a tight timeframe" are common phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "The three timeframes are worth memorising outright", từ "memorise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three timeframes are worth memorising outright", what does "memorise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: memorise /ˈmem.ə.raɪz/ (động từ): học thuộc lòng. "Memorise" (Anh) / memorize (Mỹ) = học thuộc; khác memorialise = tưởng niệm.
items.explanationEn: memorise /ˈmem.ə.raɪz/ (verb): to learn by heart. "Memorise" is British spelling, memorize American; do not confuse with memorialise.

items.question: Trong câu "They appear verbatim in questions, and "daily" corresponds to no horizon at all.", từ "verbatim" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They appear verbatim in questions, and "daily" corresponds to no horizon at all.", what does "verbatim" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: verbatim /vərˈbeɪ.tɪm/ (trạng từ): nguyên văn. "Quote verbatim" = trích dẫn nguyên văn.
items.explanationEn: verbatim /vərˈbeɪ.tɪm/ (adverb): word for word. "Quote verbatim" means repeat the exact words.

items.question: Trong câu "They appear verbatim in questions, and "daily" corresponds to no horizon at all.", từ "correspond to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They appear verbatim in questions, and "daily" corresponds to no horizon at all.", what does "correspond to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: correspond to /ˌkɒr.əˈspɒnd tuː/ (cụm từ): tương ứng với. "Correspond to" = tương ứng với; "correspond with someone" = thư từ qua lại.
items.explanationEn: correspond to /ˌkɒr.əˈspɒnd tuː/ (phrase): to match or equal. "Correspond to" means match; "correspond with someone" means exchange letters.

items.question: Trong câu "Observing change across a broad spectrum, reducing complexity in decision-making, enterprise-wide impact", từ "spectrum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Observing change across a broad spectrum, reducing complexity in decision-making, enterprise-wide impact", what does "spectrum" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spectrum /ˈspek.trəm/ (danh từ): phạm vi rộng, dải. "Across a broad spectrum" = trên phạm vi rộng; nghĩa đen là quang phổ.
items.explanationEn: spectrum /ˈspek.trəm/ (noun): a wide range. "Across a broad spectrum" means over a wide range; literally the colours of light.

items.question: Trong câu "Observing change across a broad spectrum, reducing complexity in decision-making, enterprise-wide impact", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Observing change across a broad spectrum, reducing complexity in decision-making, enterprise-wide impact", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.ti/ (danh từ): sự phức tạp. "Reduce complexity" = giảm độ phức tạp; tính từ complex.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.ti/ (noun): the state of being complicated. "Reduce complexity" is a common goal; the adjective is complex.

items.question: Trong câu "Observing change across a broad spectrum, reducing complexity in decision-making, enterprise-wide impact", từ "decision-making" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Observing change across a broad spectrum, reducing complexity in decision-making, enterprise-wide impact", what does "decision-making" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: decision-making /dɪˈsɪʒ.ən ˌmeɪ.kɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc ra quyết định. "Decision-maker" = người ra quyết định; "data-driven decision-making" = ra quyết định dựa trên dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: decision-making /dɪˈsɪʒ.ən ˌmeɪ.kɪŋ/ (noun): the process of making choices. "Decision-maker" and "data-driven decision-making" are common business terms.

items.question: Trong câu "how robust each feature must be and in what order", từ "robust" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "how robust each feature must be and in what order", what does "robust" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: robust /roʊˈbʌst/ (tính từ): vững chắc, hoàn thiện. "A robust solution" = giải pháp vững chắc, chịu được lỗi; với người nghĩa là khỏe mạnh.
items.explanationEn: robust /roʊˈbʌst/ (adjective): strong and well built. "A robust solution" handles problems well; for people it means healthy and strong.

items.question: Trong câu "Whether solution components align to real outcomes", từ "component" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whether solution components align to real outcomes", what does "component" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: component /kəmˈpoʊ.nənt/ (danh từ): thành phần. "Key component" = thành phần chính.
items.explanationEn: component /kəmˈpoʊ.nənt/ (noun): a part. "Key component" is a frequent collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "Whether solution components align to real outcomes; how robust each feature must be and in what order; exploring alternatives", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whether solution components align to real outcomes; how robust each feature must be and in what order; exploring alternatives", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːr.nə.tɪv/ (danh từ): phương án thay thế. "Explore / consider alternatives" = xem xét các phương án thay thế.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːr.nə.tɪv/ (noun): another possible option. "Explore / consider alternatives" are standard analysis phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "Preparing stories for implementation, supporting delivery, participating in retrospectives", từ "implementation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Preparing stories for implementation, supporting delivery, participating in retrospectives", what does "implementation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: implementation /ˌɪm.plɪ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự triển khai. "Implementation plan" = kế hoạch triển khai; động từ implement.
items.explanationEn: implementation /ˌɪm.plɪ.menˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): putting a plan into effect. "Implementation plan" is common; the verb is implement.

items.question: Trong câu "Preparing stories for implementation, supporting delivery, participating in retrospectives", từ "participate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Preparing stories for implementation, supporting delivery, participating in retrospectives", what does "participate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: participate /pɑːrˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (động từ): tham gia. "Participate in" = tham gia vào; danh từ participant = người tham gia.
items.explanationEn: participate /pɑːrˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (verb): to take part. "Participate in" takes the preposition in; the noun is participant.

items.question: Trong câu "Uses feedback to reorder features and re-evaluate progress toward the outcome", từ "reorder" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Uses feedback to reorder features and re-evaluate progress toward the outcome", what does "reorder" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reorder /riˈɔːr.dər/ (động từ): sắp lại thứ tự. "Reorder the backlog" = sắp lại thứ tự backlog; với hàng hóa nghĩa là đặt mua lại.
items.explanationEn: reorder /riˈɔːr.dər/ (verb): to change the order of. "Reorder the backlog" means change its order; for stock it means to order again.

items.question: Trong câu "Uses feedback to reorder features and re-evaluate progress toward the outcome", từ "progress" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Uses feedback to reorder features and re-evaluate progress toward the outcome", what does "progress" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: progress /ˈprɒɡ.res/ (danh từ): tiến độ. "Make progress" = đạt tiến bộ; "in progress" = đang thực hiện.
items.explanationEn: progress /ˈprɒɡ.res/ (noun): forward movement. "Make progress" and "in progress" are everyday workplace phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "Ensuring the defined scope is feasible for a defined budget and schedule", từ "feasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ensuring the defined scope is feasible for a defined budget and schedule", what does "feasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: feasible /ˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): khả thi. "Technically feasible" = khả thi về kỹ thuật; danh từ feasibility.
items.explanationEn: feasible /ˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): doable. "Technically feasible" is common; the noun is feasibility.

items.question: Trong câu "Ensuring the defined scope is feasible for a defined budget and schedule", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ensuring the defined scope is feasible for a defined budget and schedule", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skoʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi. "Scope creep" = phạm vi phình to ngoài kế hoạch; "in scope / out of scope" = trong / ngoài phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: scope /skoʊp/ (noun): the extent covered. "Scope creep" is uncontrolled growth; "in scope / out of scope" are common.

items.question: Trong câu "Ensuring the defined scope is feasible for a defined budget and schedule", từ "schedule" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ensuring the defined scope is feasible for a defined budget and schedule", what does "schedule" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a plan of times and dates
items.explanation: schedule /ˈskedʒ.uːl/ (danh từ): lịch trình, tiến độ. "On / behind schedule" = đúng / chậm tiến độ; trong hợp đồng schedule còn là phụ lục.
items.explanationEn: schedule /ˈskedʒ.uːl/ (noun): a plan of times and dates. "On / behind schedule" are key phrases; in contracts a schedule is also an appendix.

items.question: Trong câu "Deciding whether the initiative should be cancelled", từ "cancel" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deciding whether the initiative should be cancelled", what does "cancel" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cancel /ˈkæn.səl/ (động từ): hủy bỏ. "Cancel a meeting / project" = hủy cuộc họp / dự án; khác postpone = hoãn.
items.explanationEn: cancel /ˈkæn.səl/ (verb): to call off. "Cancel a meeting / project" means call it off; postpone only delays it.

items.question: Trong câu "The assessment repeatedly offers a fourth option that sounds official but does not exist.", từ "repeatedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The assessment repeatedly offers a fourth option that sounds official but does not exist.", what does "repeatedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.tɪd.li/ (trạng từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Repeatedly" = nhiều lần; "repeatedly asked" = được hỏi đi hỏi lại.
items.explanationEn: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.tɪd.li/ (adverb): again and again. "Repeatedly asked" means asked many times.

items.question: Trong câu "The assessment repeatedly offers a fourth option that sounds official but does not exist.", từ "official" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The assessment repeatedly offers a fourth option that sounds official but does not exist.", what does "official" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: official /əˈfɪʃ.əl/ (tính từ): chính thức. "Official documentation" = tài liệu chính thức; danh từ official = quan chức.
items.explanationEn: official /əˈfɪʃ.əl/ (adjective): formally approved. "Official documentation" is formal; as a noun an official is a public officer.

items.question: Trong câu "Learn this list and you can eliminate an option instantly on a great many questions", từ "instantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Learn this list and you can eliminate an option instantly on a great many questions", what does "instantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. "Instantly recognisable" = nhận ra ngay lập tức.
items.explanationEn: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (adverb): immediately. "Instantly recognisable" is a common collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "Learn this list and you can eliminate an option instantly on a great many questions", từ "a great many" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Learn this list and you can eliminate an option instantly on a great many questions", what does "a great many" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: a great many /ə ɡreɪt ˈmen.i/ (cụm từ): rất nhiều. "A great many" = rất nhiều (trang trọng), đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều.
items.explanationEn: a great many /ə ɡreɪt ˈmen.i/ (phrase): a very large number of. "A great many" is a formal way to say very many, used with plural countable nouns.

items.question: Trong câu "This holds beyond horizons too", từ "beyond" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This holds beyond horizons too", what does "beyond" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: beyond /biˈjɒnd/ (giới từ): vượt ra ngoài. "Beyond the scope" = ngoài phạm vi; "beyond doubt" = không còn nghi ngờ.
items.explanationEn: beyond /biˈjɒnd/ (preposition): outside the limits of. "Beyond the scope" and "beyond doubt" are common phrases.

items.question: Trong câu ""business value map" and "design spike" are inventions of the same kind.", từ "invention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""business value map" and "design spike" are inventions of the same kind.", what does "invention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: invention /ɪnˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): điều bịa đặt. "Invention" ở đây = điều bịa ra; nghĩa quen thuộc là phát minh.
items.explanationEn: invention /ɪnˈven.ʃən/ (noun): something made up. "Invention" here means something made up; the familiar sense is a new device.

items.question: Trong câu ""business value map" and "design spike" are inventions of the same kind.", từ "of the same kind" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""business value map" and "design spike" are inventions of the same kind.", what does "of the same kind" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: of the same kind /əv ðə seɪm kaɪnd/ (cụm từ): cùng một loại. "Of the same kind" = cùng loại; kind ở đây là danh từ (loại), không phải tính từ (tử tế).
items.explanationEn: of the same kind /əv ðə seɪm kaɪnd/ (phrase): of the same type. "Of the same kind" uses kind as a noun (type), not the adjective (nice).

items.question: Trong câu "Planning the details of the coming iteration in a planning workshop", từ "workshop" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning the details of the coming iteration in a planning workshop", what does "workshop" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: workshop /ˈwɜːrk.ʃɒp/ (danh từ): buổi làm việc nhóm. "Run a workshop" = tổ chức buổi làm việc nhóm; nghĩa đen là xưởng.
items.explanationEn: workshop /ˈwɜːrk.ʃɒp/ (noun): a group working session. "Run a workshop" means lead a working session; literally a workshop is a place for making things.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysis done directly with customers and stakeholders over a short timeframe", từ "directly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysis done directly with customers and stakeholders over a short timeframe", what does "directly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: directly /dəˈrekt.li/ (trạng từ): trực tiếp. "Work directly with" = làm việc trực tiếp với; "report directly to" = báo cáo trực tiếp cho.
items.explanationEn: directly /dəˈrekt.li/ (adverb): without anyone in between. "Work directly with" and "report directly to" are common job-description phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "Deciding the order of features to implement next, using new usage information", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deciding the order of features to implement next, using new usage information", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (động từ): triển khai. "Implement a feature" = hiện thực một tính năng; danh từ implement còn nghĩa là dụng cụ.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (verb): to put into action. "Implement a feature" means build it; as a noun an implement is a tool.

items.question: Trong câu "Deciding the order of features to implement next, using new usage information", từ "usage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deciding the order of features to implement next, using new usage information", what does "usage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: usage /ˈjuː.sɪdʒ/ (danh từ): mức độ sử dụng. "Usage data" = dữ liệu sử dụng; trong ngôn ngữ học usage = cách dùng từ.
items.explanationEn: usage /ˈjuː.sɪdʒ/ (noun): the amount of use. "Usage data" shows how a product is used; in grammar usage means how words are used.

items.question: Trong câu "Checking that solution components are aligned to getting real outcomes", từ "align" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Checking that solution components are aligned to getting real outcomes", what does "align" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in a straight line
items.explanation: align /əˈlaɪn/ (động từ): đồng bộ, hướng theo. "Be aligned with / to" = phù hợp, hướng theo (mục tiêu); nghĩa đen là căn thẳng hàng.
items.explanationEn: align /əˈlaɪn/ (verb): to bring into agreement with. "Be aligned with / to goals" means in agreement; literally to put in a straight line.

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog refinement — prioritising and sequencing features, ongoing and repeated", từ "ongoing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog refinement — prioritising and sequencing features, ongoing and repeated", what does "ongoing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ongoing /ˈɒnˌɡoʊ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): đang diễn ra. "Ongoing project / support" = dự án / hỗ trợ đang tiếp diễn.
items.explanationEn: ongoing /ˈɒnˌɡoʊ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): still happening. "Ongoing project / support" means still in progress.

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog refinement — prioritising and sequencing features, ongoing and repeated", từ "prioritise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog refinement — prioritising and sequencing features, ongoing and repeated", what does "prioritise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prioritise /praɪˈɒr.ə.taɪz/ (động từ): xếp thứ tự ưu tiên. "Prioritise tasks" = xếp ưu tiên công việc; danh từ priority.
items.explanationEn: prioritise /praɪˈɒr.ə.taɪz/ (verb): to rank by importance. "Prioritise tasks" is a core skill; the noun is priority.

items.question: Trong câu "Thinking about how a small change may affect the whole enterprise", từ "affect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Thinking about how a small change may affect the whole enterprise", what does "affect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: affect /əˈfekt/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng đến. "Affect" (động từ) = ảnh hưởng; effect (danh từ) = kết quả. Nghĩa khác: giả vờ.
items.explanationEn: affect /əˈfekt/ (verb): to have an effect on. "Affect" is the verb and effect the noun; affect can also mean to pretend.

items.question: Trong câu "Setting organisational goals and the metrics that measure them", từ "metric" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Setting organisational goals and the metrics that measure them", what does "metric" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (danh từ): chỉ số đo lường. "Key metrics" = chỉ số chính; tính từ metric còn chỉ hệ mét.
items.explanationEn: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (noun): a measure of performance. "Key metrics" measure performance; metric also refers to the metre-based system.

items.question: Trong câu "Setting organisational goals and the metrics that measure them", từ "measure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Setting organisational goals and the metrics that measure them", what does "measure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (động từ): đo lường. "Measure success" = đo lường thành công; danh từ measure còn là biện pháp (take measures).
items.explanationEn: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (verb): to quantify. "Measure success" is common; as a noun, take measures means take action.

items.question: Trong câu "A fast reading heuristic: find the unit of work in the sentence.", từ "heuristic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A fast reading heuristic: find the unit of work in the sentence.", what does "heuristic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: heuristic /hjʊˈrɪs.tɪk/ (danh từ): mẹo suy luận nhanh. "Heuristic" = quy tắc kinh nghiệm giúp quyết định nhanh, không đảm bảo tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: heuristic /hjʊˈrɪs.tɪk/ (noun): a rule of thumb. "Heuristic" is a practical shortcut that usually, but not always, works.

items.question: Trong câu "A fast reading heuristic: find the unit of work in the sentence.", từ "unit of work" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A fast reading heuristic: find the unit of work in the sentence.", what does "unit of work" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: unit of work /ˈjuː.nɪt əv wɜːrk/ (cụm từ): đơn vị công việc. "Unit" = đơn vị; "unit of work" là mức công việc (story, feature, initiative).
items.explanationEn: unit of work /ˈjuː.nɪt əv wɜːrk/ (phrase): a single piece of work. "Unit of work" is the size of the item being discussed (story, feature, initiative).

items.question: Trong câu "Two techniques are exploited deliberately because they live in several horizons at once.", từ "exploit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two techniques are exploited deliberately because they live in several horizons at once.", what does "exploit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (động từ): tận dụng, khai thác. "Exploit" = tận dụng; với người thì mang nghĩa xấu là bóc lột. "Exploit a vulnerability" = khai thác lỗ hổng.
items.explanationEn: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (verb): to make use of. "Exploit" means make use of; with people it means treat unfairly. "Exploit a vulnerability" is a security term.

items.question: Trong câu "Two techniques are exploited deliberately because they live in several horizons at once.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two techniques are exploited deliberately because they live in several horizons at once.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): cố ý. "Deliberately" = cố ý; ngoài ra còn nghĩa là thong thả, cân nhắc (speak deliberately).
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. "Deliberately" means on purpose; it can also mean slowly and carefully.

items.question: Trong câu "Planning workshops exist in all three horizons, differing only in level of detail", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning workshops exist in all three horizons, differing only in level of detail", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (động từ): khác nhau. "Differ in / from" = khác nhau về / khác với; "differ with someone" = bất đồng.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ in / from" means be unlike; "differ with someone" means disagree.

items.question: Trong câu "creating a shared understanding of the approach to constructing the solution", từ "shared" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "creating a shared understanding of the approach to constructing the solution", what does "shared" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: shared /ʃerd/ (tính từ): chung, cùng có. "Shared understanding" = hiểu biết chung giữa các thành viên.
items.explanationEn: shared /ʃerd/ (adjective): held in common. "Shared understanding" is what a team builds together.

items.question: Trong câu "creating a shared understanding of the approach to constructing the solution", từ "approach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "creating a shared understanding of the approach to constructing the solution", what does "approach" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a road leading to a place
items.explanation: approach /əˈproʊtʃ/ (danh từ): cách tiếp cận. "Take an approach" = áp dụng cách tiếp cận; nghĩa khác là lối vào (the approach to the airport).
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈproʊtʃ/ (noun): a method of working. "Take an approach" means use a method; it can also mean the road to a place.

items.question: Trong câu "creating a shared understanding of the approach to constructing the solution", từ "construct" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "creating a shared understanding of the approach to constructing the solution", what does "construct" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: construct /kənˈstrʌkt/ (động từ): xây dựng. "Construct a solution / an argument" = xây dựng giải pháp / lập luận.
items.explanationEn: construct /kənˈstrʌkt/ (verb): to build. "Construct a solution / an argument" are common collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "Value modeling depends on what it is being used for", từ "depend on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Value modeling depends on what it is being used for", what does "depend on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (cụm từ): phụ thuộc vào. "It depends on..." = còn tùy vào...; nghĩa khác: dựa dẫm, tin cậy (depend on someone).
items.explanationEn: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (phrase): to be decided by. "It depends on..." means it varies with; "depend on someone" means rely on them.

items.question: Trong câu "Used to inform research and development, marketing and sales", từ "inform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Used to inform research and development, marketing and sales", what does "inform" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inform /ɪnˈfɔːrm/ (động từ): làm cơ sở cho. "Inform decisions" = làm cơ sở cho quyết định; nghĩa quen là thông báo (inform someone of).
items.explanationEn: inform /ɪnˈfɔːrm/ (verb): to guide or shape. "Inform decisions" means give them a basis; "inform someone of" means tell them.

items.question: Trong câu "looking at the customers of the organisation as a whole", từ "as a whole" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "looking at the customers of the organisation as a whole", what does "as a whole" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: as a whole /æz ə hoʊl/ (cụm từ): nói chung, toàn bộ. "The company as a whole" = toàn công ty nói chung.
items.explanationEn: as a whole /æz ə hoʊl/ (phrase): taken all together. "The company as a whole" means considering all of it together.

items.question: Trong câu "it ties day-to-day activity back to organisational goals", từ "tie back to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it ties day-to-day activity back to organisational goals", what does "tie back to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tie back to /taɪ bæk tuː/ (cụm từ): liên hệ lại với. "Tie A back to B" = liên hệ A trở lại với B; "tie in with" = khớp với.
items.explanationEn: tie back to /taɪ bæk tuː/ (phrase): to connect back to. "Tie A back to B" means show the link; "tie in with" means fit with.

items.question: Trong câu "it ties day-to-day activity back to organisational goals", từ "day-to-day" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it ties day-to-day activity back to organisational goals", what does "day-to-day" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: day-to-day /ˌdeɪ.təˈdeɪ/ (tính từ): thường nhật. "Day-to-day operations" = hoạt động thường nhật.
items.explanationEn: day-to-day /ˌdeɪ.təˈdeɪ/ (adjective): happening every day. "Day-to-day operations" is a common business phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "so it enhances the feedback loops between all three horizons.", từ "enhance" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so it enhances the feedback loops between all three horizons.", what does "enhance" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enhance /ɪnˈhæns/ (động từ): nâng cao. "Enhance performance" = nâng cao hiệu suất; danh từ enhancement.
items.explanationEn: enhance /ɪnˈhæns/ (verb): to improve. "Enhance performance" is common; the noun is enhancement.

items.question: Trong câu "so it enhances the feedback loops between all three horizons.", từ "feedback loop" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so it enhances the feedback loops between all three horizons.", what does "feedback loop" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a cycle of learning from results
items.explanation: feedback loop /ˈfiːd.bæk luːp/ (cụm từ): vòng phản hồi. "Shorten the feedback loop" = rút ngắn vòng phản hồi để học nhanh hơn.
items.explanationEn: feedback loop /ˈfiːd.bæk luːp/ (phrase): a cycle of learning from results. "Shorten the feedback loop" means learn from results faster.

items.question: Trong câu "A distinct question type asks the inverse", từ "inverse" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A distinct question type asks the inverse", what does "inverse" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: inverse /ˈɪn.vɜːrs/ (danh từ): điều ngược lại. "The inverse" = điều ngược lại; "inverse relationship" = quan hệ nghịch.
items.explanationEn: inverse /ˈɪn.vɜːrs/ (noun): the opposite. "The inverse" is the opposite; an "inverse relationship" goes in opposite directions.

items.question: Trong câu "Conversely, at the delivery horizon the BA does get stories ready for implementation", từ "conversely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conversely, at the delivery horizon the BA does get stories ready for implementation", what does "conversely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: conversely /kənˈvɜːrs.li/ (trạng từ): ngược lại. "Conversely" = ngược lại, dùng để nêu ý đối lập với câu trước.
items.explanationEn: conversely /kənˈvɜːrs.li/ (adverb): on the other hand. "Conversely" introduces the opposite of the previous point.

items.question: Trong câu "There is also a question from the leadership angle", từ "angle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is also a question from the leadership angle", what does "angle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: angle /ˈæŋ.ɡəl/ (danh từ): góc độ, khía cạnh. "From a different angle" = từ góc độ khác; nghĩa đen là góc hình học.
items.explanationEn: angle /ˈæŋ.ɡəl/ (noun): a point of view. "From a different angle" means another viewpoint; literally a geometric angle.

items.question: Trong câu "defining the product roadmap, identifying the desired business value", từ "roadmap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "defining the product roadmap, identifying the desired business value", what does "roadmap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: roadmap /ˈroʊd.mæp/ (danh từ): lộ trình (sản phẩm). "Product roadmap" = lộ trình sản phẩm; nghĩa đen là bản đồ đường bộ.
items.explanationEn: roadmap /ˈroʊd.mæp/ (noun): a plan over time. "Product roadmap" is a plan over time; literally a map of roads.

items.question: Trong câu "defining the product roadmap, identifying the desired business value", từ "desired" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "defining the product roadmap, identifying the desired business value", what does "desired" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: desired /dɪˈzaɪərd/ (tính từ): mong muốn. "Desired outcome" = kết quả mong muốn.
items.explanationEn: desired /dɪˈzaɪərd/ (adjective): wanted. "Desired outcome" is a common planning phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "defining the product roadmap, identifying the desired business value", từ "identify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "defining the product roadmap, identifying the desired business value", what does "identify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: identify /aɪˈden.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): xác định. "Identify risks" = xác định rủi ro; "identify with someone" = đồng cảm với ai.
items.explanationEn: identify /aɪˈden.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to pinpoint. "Identify risks" means find them; "identify with someone" means feel close to them.

items.question: Trong câu "not by fixing the first phase's budget, the technical context, or the release plan.", từ "fix" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "not by fixing the first phase's budget, the technical context, or the release plan.", what does "fix" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fix /fɪks/ (động từ): ấn định, cố định. "Fix a budget / a date" = ấn định ngân sách / ngày; nghĩa khác là sửa (fix a bug).
items.explanationEn: fix /fɪks/ (verb): to set firmly. "Fix a budget / a date" means set it; the other sense is repair (fix a bug).

items.question: Trong câu "that is the older project frame, not the initiative focus.", từ "frame" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "that is the older project frame, not the initiative focus.", what does "frame" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: frame /freɪm/ (danh từ): khung tư duy, cách nhìn. "Frame of reference" = hệ quy chiếu, khung tư duy; nghĩa đen là khung (ảnh, cửa).
items.explanationEn: frame /freɪm/ (noun): a way of viewing things. "Frame of reference" is a way of viewing; literally a border around a picture.

items.question: Trong câu "eliminate on sight", từ "on sight" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "eliminate on sight", what does "on sight" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on sight /ɒn saɪt/ (cụm từ): ngay khi nhìn thấy. "On sight" = ngay khi thấy; khác "on site" = tại hiện trường.
items.explanationEn: on sight /ɒn saɪt/ (phrase): as soon as seen. "On sight" means as soon as seen; do not confuse with "on site" (at the location).

items.question: Trong câu "impact mapping links all three.", từ "link" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "impact mapping links all three.", what does "link" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: link /lɪŋk/ (động từ): liên kết. "Link A to B" = liên kết A với B; "be linked to" = có liên quan đến.
items.explanationEn: link /lɪŋk/ (verb): to connect. "Link A to B" means connect; "be linked to" means be related to.

items.question: Trong câu "The strategy horizon uses feedback from all horizons to feed strategy.", từ "feed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The strategy horizon uses feedback from all horizons to feed strategy.", what does "feed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: feed /fiːd/ (động từ): làm đầu vào cho. "Feed into" = làm đầu vào cho; nghĩa đen là cho ăn.
items.explanationEn: feed /fiːd/ (verb): to supply input to. "Feed into" means provide input; literally to give food.

items.question: Trong câu "The strategy horizon uses feedback from all horizons to feed strategy.", từ "feedback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The strategy horizon uses feedback from all horizons to feed strategy.", what does "feedback" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feedback /ˈfiːd.bæk/ (danh từ): phản hồi, ý kiến. "Give / get feedback" = đưa / nhận phản hồi; trong âm thanh là tiếng rít từ loa.
items.explanationEn: feedback /ˈfiːd.bæk/ (noun): comments on results. "Give / get feedback" is everyday; in audio it is the howl from a speaker.
